## Task
An agent must build a target design in a brick world.
- The world is a 8 x 8 base, up to 6 layers high. Bricks are one layer high with footprints 1x1, 1x2, 2x1 or 2x2.
- A placed brick drops until it rests on the highest filled cell under its footprint (or the ground), so overhangs with empty cells under them are possible and placement order matters.
- Each step the agent picks a brick type and an anchor cell, or DONE. An episode ends at DONE or after 33 placements. Bricks cannot be removed.
- Target designs are made by 6 to 16 random brick drops. Training uses a stream of fresh random designs; the held-out designs never appear in training.

## Training and evaluation

Compute counts one forward pass to collect each sample (a third of a forward-and-backward pass) and one forward-and-backward pass per sample per PPO epoch. So a trial trains for 131,072 x (4 + 1/3) / ((ppo_epochs + 1/3) x r) steps, rounded down to whole updates of n_envs x rollout_len steps, where r is the network's training FLOPs per sample relative to the starting architecture (r below 1 counts as 1). More epochs or a bigger network means fewer samples; fewer epochs means more. The budget must allow at least 4 updates.
- In this search you choose the network and the training recipe. To set the recipe, add one top-level constant to your file, `RECIPE = {...}`, a literal dict with any of these keys and bounds: lr 1e-4 to 3e-3; n_envs 64 to 1024 (integer, parallel worlds per update); rollout_len 8 to 64 (integer); n_minibatches 4 to 64 (integer, must divide n_envs x rollout_len, at least 64 samples per minibatch); ppo_epochs 1 to 8 (integer); ent_coef 0 to 0.05; gamma 0.9 to 0.995; gae_lambda 0.8 to 0.99; clip_eps 0.1 to 0.3. - Fixed for every trial: Adam with the learning rate decaying linearly to 0, value coefficient 0.5, gradient-norm clip 1.0, normalised advantages. Reward per placement: (target cells filled minus cells filled outside the target) / the target's cell count, minus 0.01; plus 1 when the episode ends with an exact build.

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)
```

```python
STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40

        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)

        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

        super().__init__()
        self.X = int(spec.X)
```

```python
            nn.Conv2d(2 * spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        o = torch.cat([obs, torch.roll(obs, shifts=self.X // 2, dims=3)], dim=1)
        s = self.stem(o)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c3(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)
```

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {'ppo_epochs': 1, 'lr': 0.003}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(2 * spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        o = torch.cat([obs, torch.roll(obs, shifts=self.X // 2, dims=3)], dim=1)
        s = self.stem(o)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)
